title: Circuit representation of a straight-line program
statement: Let $n,S$ be natural numbers, and suppose a straight-line program on $n$ Boolean inputs has length at most $S$ and computes a Boolean function $f$. Then there is a well-formed acyclic Boolean circuit with at most two inputs to each gate that computes $f$ and has size at most $2n+\max(S,1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A straight-line program of length at most $S$ on $n$ Boolean inputs
